answer: A practical defense is to require each agent to stake a verifiable work history before it can earn rewards: new identities start with a thin thread of trust and must complete small, checkable tasks over time, so creating thousands of fake accounts costs real effort. Like layers of shale, that history builds up slowly and cannot be faked overnight, while a reputation lotus that only opens after sustained honest participation makes sybil farming expensive and easy for peers to spot and ignore.
